skill_manual.name: 技能指南
skill_manual.desc: 一本記載著強大武技與魔法原理的古老書冊。可於技能強化選單中消耗，無視金幣與熟練度需求升級技能。
skill_manual.desc_en: An ancient tome containing powerful martial and magical principles. Consume it to upgrade a skill, ignoring gold and proficiency requirements.

forging_stone.name: 極致鍛造石
forging_stone.desc: 蘊含強大能量的礦石。交給鐵匠可直接無償強化武器或防具，必定成功。
forging_stone.desc_en: An ore brimming with immense energy. Give it to a blacksmith to guarantee a free equipment upgrade.

wolf_fur.name: 完整狼皮
wolf_fur.desc_en: Can be used to make warm clothing.

raw_meat.name: 生肉
raw_meat.desc: 看起來不太新鮮的肉塊
raw_meat.desc_en: A chunk of meat that doesn't look very fresh.

boar_tusk.name: 野豬獠牙
boar_tusk.desc: 鋒利的獠牙，拿來當飾品也不錯
boar_tusk.desc_en: A sharp tusk that also makes for a decent accessory.

poison_stinger.name: 毒蜂針
poison_stinger.desc_en: A sharp stinger laced with deadly venom.

ancient_wood.name: 古老靈木
ancient_wood.desc_en: Hardy timber that gives off a faint glow.

royal_honey.name: 蜂后凝脂
royal_honey.desc_en: An extremely rare and precious tonic.

bone_shard.name: 骸骨碎片
bone_shard.desc_en: A broken bone steeped in dark energy.

stolen_gem.name: 盜來的寶石
stolen_gem.desc: 哥布林不知從哪偷來的亮晶晶寶石
stolen_gem.desc_en: A glittering gem the goblins stole from who-knows-where.

lich_soulstone.name: 巫妖魂石
lich_soulstone.desc: 封印著強大死靈魔力的石頭
lich_soulstone.desc_en: A stone sealing away powerful necromantic energy.

bat_wing.name: 巨大蝙蝠翼
bat_wing.desc: 充滿韌性的皮革質地翅膀
bat_wing.desc_en: A wing with a tough, leathery texture.

tainted_blood.name: 污穢之血
tainted_blood.desc: 裝在小瓶子裡的暗紅色液體
tainted_blood.desc_en: A dark red liquid sealed inside a small vial.

rusty_dagger.name: 生鏽的匕首
rusty_dagger.desc: 雖然鈍，但捅人還是會痛
rusty_dagger.desc_en: Dull, maybe, but it still hurts when it stabs you.

bronze_sword.name: 青銅長劍
bronze_sword.desc: 比木劍可靠的正規武器
bronze_sword.desc_en: A proper weapon, more reliable than a wooden sword.

iron_sword.name: 精鋼長劍
iron_sword.desc: 散發冷冽光芒的正規武器
iron_sword.desc_en: A proper weapon that gleams with a cold light.

flame_sword.name: 火焰之劍
flame_sword.desc: 劍身灼熱，普攻有機率使敵人燃燒
flame_sword.desc_en: Its blade burns with heat. Basic attacks have a chance to set enemies on fire.

hero_sword.name: 勇者之劍
hero_sword.desc: 傳說洞窟深處的石墩上插著的聖劍，纏繞著令魔王忌憚的聖光。對戰魔王薩格拉斯時，能大幅削弱他的力量。
hero_sword.desc_en: A legendary holy sword said to be lodged in a stone pedestal deep within a cave, wreathed in holy light that the Demon Lord fears. Greatly weakens Demon Lord Sargeras when used against him.

holy_sword.name: 聖光之劍
holy_sword.desc: 每次攻擊回復自身 8% 最大 HP
holy_sword.desc_en: Restores 8% of your max HP with every attack.

mage_staff.name: 巫師法杖
mage_staff.desc_en: Boosts magic power. Suited for spellcasters.

dragon_plate.name: 龍鱗重甲
dragon_plate.desc: 傳說級防具，大幅提升防禦與生命上限
dragon_plate.desc_en: Legendary armor that greatly boosts defense and max HP.

schrodinger_watch.name: 薛丁格的懷錶
schrodinger_watch.desc: 純粹賭徒的浪漫。攻擊時 50% 機率傷害翻倍，50% 減半
schrodinger_watch.desc_en: A true gambler's romance. When attacking, 50% chance to double damage, 50% chance to halve it.

apprentice_staff.name: 學徒法杖
apprentice_staff.desc: 適合剛學會魔法的新手
apprentice_staff.desc_en: Suited for those who have just learned magic.

sage_staff.name: 賢者之杖
sage_staff.desc: 蘊含龐大魔力的高階法杖
sage_staff.desc_en: A high-tier staff containing immense magical power.

scroll_power_slash.name: 技能卷軸：強力斬擊
scroll_power_slash.desc: 研讀後可習得【強力斬擊】

scroll_heal_light.name: 技能卷軸：初級治療
scroll_heal_light.desc: 研讀後可習得【初級治療】

jester_mask.name: 小丑面具
jester_mask.desc: 裝備後每日免疫隨機異常狀態
jester_mask.desc_en: While equipped, grants daily immunity to a random status ailment.

magic_shard_emerald.name: 翠綠魔法碎片
magic_shard_emerald.desc: 【主線】精靈長老守護的魔法碎片，蘊含森林的生命力。集齊三色碎片可在手藝工坊合成【魔法之眼】。
magic_shard_emerald.desc_en: [Main Quest] A magic shard guarded by the Elven Elder, brimming with the forest's vitality. Gather all three shards to craft the [Eye of Insight] at the workshop.

magic_shard_amethyst.name: 幽紫魔法碎片
magic_shard_amethyst.desc: 【主線】亡靈學者研究多年的魔法碎片，迴盪著冥界的低語。集齊三色碎片可在手藝工坊合成【魔法之眼】。
magic_shard_amethyst.desc_en: [Main Quest] A magic shard the Undead Scholar studied for years, echoing with whispers of the underworld. Gather all three shards to craft the [Eye of Insight] at the workshop.

magic_shard_crimson.name: 緋紅魔法碎片
magic_shard_crimson.desc: 【主線】龍語者世代相傳的魔法碎片，燃燒著遠古龍族的意志。集齊三色碎片可在手藝工坊合成【魔法之眼】。
magic_shard_crimson.desc_en: [Main Quest] A magic shard passed down by generations of Dragonspeakers, burning with the will of the ancient dragons. Gather all three shards to craft the [Eye of Insight] at the workshop.

magic_eye.name: 魔法之眼
magic_eye.desc: 【主線】三色魔法碎片合成的神祕魔眼。放在行囊中即可看穿敵人的屬性弱點，並在傳說洞窟中指引勇者之劍的方向。
magic_eye.desc_en: [Main Quest] A mystic eye forged from the three magic shards. While in your bag it reveals enemies' elemental weaknesses and points the way to the Hero's Sword within the Legendary Cave.

immortal_totem.name: 不死圖騰
immortal_totem.desc: 放在背包裡，致死瞬間自動消耗，免除死亡並回復 50% 狀態，資本主義的奇蹟
immortal_totem.desc_en: Kept in your bag, it's automatically consumed the instant you would die, preventing death and restoring 50% of your stats — a miracle of capitalism.

mystery_phoenix_feather.name: 神秘鳳羽
mystery_phoenix_feather.desc: 神秘商人專賣，據說蘊含著重生的力量
mystery_phoenix_feather.desc_en: Sold only by the Mysterious Merchant. Said to contain the power of rebirth.

mystery_void_blade.name: 虛空短刃
mystery_void_blade.desc: 神秘商人專賣，虛空之力纏繞的終極利刃
mystery_void_blade.desc_en: Sold only by the Mysterious Merchant. An ultimate blade wreathed in the power of the void.

mystery_elixir.name: 賢者萬靈藥
mystery_elixir.desc: 神秘商人專賣，完全回復 HP
mystery_elixir.desc_en: Sold only by the Mysterious Merchant. Fully restores HP.

mystery_mana_elixir.name: 賢者魔力藥
mystery_mana_elixir.desc: 神秘商人專賣，完全回復 MP
mystery_mana_elixir.desc_en: Sold only by the Mysterious Merchant. Fully restores MP.

mystery_chaos_staff.name: 混沌法杖
mystery_chaos_staff.desc: 神秘商人專賣，法師夢寐以求的極致魔杖
mystery_chaos_staff.desc_en: Sold only by the Mysterious Merchant. The ultimate staff every mage dreams of.

mystery_demon_armor.name: 魔王重甲
mystery_demon_armor.desc: 神秘商人專賣，堅不可摧的絕世重甲
mystery_demon_armor.desc_en: Sold only by the Mysterious Merchant. Unbreakable, peerless heavy armor.

mystery_power_ring.name: 力量之戒
mystery_power_ring.desc: 神秘商人專賣，配戴後大幅提升雙攻的戒指
mystery_power_ring.desc_en: Sold only by the Mysterious Merchant. A ring that greatly boosts both attack and magic when worn.

mystery_time_hourglass.name: 時光沙漏
mystery_time_hourglass.desc: 神秘商人專賣，打碎後時間為你加速，3 回合內速度提升為 2 倍
mystery_time_hourglass.desc_en: Sold only by the Mysterious Merchant. Shatter it to bend time in your favor: doubles your Speed for 3 turns.

mystery_lucky_coin.name: 幸運金幣
mystery_lucky_coin.desc: 神秘商人專賣，純粹用來證明你錢多到沒處花的無用硬幣
mystery_lucky_coin.desc_en: Sold only by the Mysterious Merchant. A useless coin that exists purely to prove you have more money than you know what to do with.

sargeras_crown.name: 薩格拉斯的魔冠
sargeras_crown.desc: 散發著無盡魔力的王冠，魔王薩格拉斯的遺物。
sargeras_crown.desc_en: A crown radiating endless magic power, a relic of Demon Lord Sargeras.

demon_core.name: 惡魔核心
demon_core.desc_en: A crystal of pure abyssal energy.

void_crystal.name: 虛空水晶
void_crystal.desc: 蘊含虛空之力的罕見礦物。
void_crystal.desc_en: A rare mineral containing the power of the void.

demon_king_horn.name: 魔王之角
demon_king_horn.desc: 折斷的惡魔之角，帶有狂暴的魔力。大幅提升攻擊與魔力，但會讓防禦力嚴重下降。
demon_king_horn.desc_en: A broken demon horn pulsing with savage magic. Greatly boosts attack and magic, but severely lowers defense.

abyssal_cloak.name: 深淵潛航者披風
abyssal_cloak.desc: 融入黑夜的披風，讓你難以被命中，但揮舞武器時會變得無力。
abyssal_cloak.desc_en: A cloak that blends into the night, making you hard to hit, but it saps your strength when wielding a weapon.

dragonbone_greatsword.name: 龍骨毀滅劍
dragonbone_greatsword.desc: 用墮落巨龍的脊椎打磨而成的巨劍，威力無窮但極為沉重。
dragonbone_greatsword.desc_en: A massive sword forged from the spine of the Fallen Dragon, immensely powerful but extremely heavy.

forbidden_blood_chalice.name: 禁忌血之聖杯
forbidden_blood_chalice.desc: 裝滿鮮血的聖杯，能大幅增幅體能，但會降低魔法防禦力。
forbidden_blood_chalice.desc_en: A chalice brimming with blood that greatly enhances physical prowess, but lowers magic defense.

scroll_mana_surge.name: 技能卷軸：魔力湧泉
scroll_mana_surge.desc: 研讀後可習得【魔力湧泉】

guardian_hammer.name: 守護者戰錘
guardian_hammer.desc: 【史詩・守護者套裝】沉重而可靠。套裝：2件+防禦/HP，3件再+攻擊/魔防
guardian_hammer.desc_en: [Epic - Guardian Set] Heavy and dependable. Set: 2pc +DEF/HP, 3pc adds ATK/MDEF.

guardian_plate.name: 守護者鎧甲
guardian_plate.desc: 【史詩・守護者套裝】厚重的全身板甲。套裝：2件+防禦/HP，3件再+攻擊/魔防
guardian_plate.desc_en: [Epic - Guardian Set] Heavy full plate. Set: 2pc +DEF/HP, 3pc adds ATK/MDEF.

guardian_charm.name: 守護者護符
guardian_charm.desc: 【史詩・守護者套裝】溫暖的守護之力。套裝：2件+防禦/HP，3件再+攻擊/魔防
guardian_charm.desc_en: [Epic - Guardian Set] A warm, protective aura. Set: 2pc +DEF/HP, 3pc adds ATK/MDEF.

archmage_staff.name: 大法師法杖
archmage_staff.desc: 【史詩・大法師套裝】蘊含澎湃魔力的法杖。套裝：2件+魔力/MP，3件再+抗性
archmage_staff.desc_en: [Epic - Archmage Set] A staff brimming with magic. Set: 2pc +MAG/MP, 3pc adds RES.

archmage_robe.name: 大法師長袍
archmage_robe.desc: 【史詩・大法師套裝】繡滿符文的長袍。套裝：2件+魔力/MP，3件再+抗性
archmage_robe.desc_en: [Epic - Archmage Set] A robe embroidered with runes. Set: 2pc +MAG/MP, 3pc adds RES.

archmage_orb.name: 大法師魔導球
archmage_orb.desc: 【史詩・大法師套裝】漂浮的魔導結晶。套裝：2件+魔力/MP，3件再+抗性
archmage_orb.desc_en: [Epic - Archmage Set] A floating arcane crystal. Set: 2pc +MAG/MP, 3pc adds RES.

windrunner_pendant.name: 馭風墜飾
windrunner_pendant.desc: 【稀有】讓你身輕如燕，攻擊更快更準
windrunner_pendant.desc_en: [Rare] Light as a swallow — faster, sharper strikes.

berserker_axe.name: 狂戰士巨斧
berserker_axe.desc: 【稀有】極致的攻擊，但疏於防守（防禦 -6）
berserker_axe.desc_en: [Rare] Maximum offense at the cost of defense (DEF -6).

rusty_shortbow.name: 生鏽短弓
rusty_shortbow.desc_en: An entry-level bow that favors speed.

novice_wand.name: 見習法杖
novice_wand.desc: 魔法學徒的第一根法杖

travelers_charm.name: 旅人護符
travelers_charm.desc: 保佑旅途平安的小護符
travelers_charm.desc_en: A small charm blessing safe travels.

wolf_fang_dagger.name: 狼牙匕首
wolf_fang_dagger.desc: 沾染狼毒的匕首，攻擊時有機率使敵人中毒
wolf_fang_dagger.desc_en: A dagger tainted with wolf venom; attacks may poison the enemy.

swift_boots.name: 疾風之靴
swift_boots.desc: 讓腳步變得飄逸的靴子
swift_boots.desc_en: Boots that make your steps feel weightless.

hide_armor.name: 獸皮輕甲
hide_armor.desc: 用森林猛獸皮革製成的輕甲
hide_armor.desc_en: Light armor made from forest beast hides.

ranger_bow.name: 遊俠之弓
ranger_bow.desc_en: The faster you are, the harder this hits.

ember_wand.name: 餘燼法杖
ember_wand.desc: 纏繞著微弱火焰的法杖
ember_wand.desc_en: A wand wreathed in faint flame.

stinger_rapier.name: 毒針細劍
stinger_rapier.desc_en: A rapier with a venom-tipped point.

thorn_staff.name: 荊棘法杖
thorn_staff.desc_en: A staff wound with thorny vines.

bark_armor.name: 樹皮鎧甲
bark_armor.desc_en: Armor as tough as ancient bark.

iron_will_ring.name: 鋼鐵意志之戒
iron_will_ring.desc_en: A ring that steels the wearer's resolve.

lucky_clover_charm.name: 幸運四葉草
lucky_clover_charm.desc: 據說能帶來好運的四葉草
lucky_clover_charm.desc_en: A clover said to bring good fortune.

shadow_dagger.name: 暗影匕首
shadow_dagger.desc: 潛行者愛用的輕薄匕首
shadow_dagger.desc_en: A slim dagger favored by stalkers.

assassin_hood.name: 刺客兜帽
assassin_hood.desc_en: A light hood that conceals the face.

assassin_ring.name: 刺客指環
assassin_ring.desc_en: A token of the assassins' guild.

experimental_blade.name: 實驗鋒刃
experimental_blade.desc_en: A blade tainted with experimental chemicals.

hazmat_plate.name: 防護鋼甲
hazmat_plate.desc: 專為抵抗異常狀態與魔防設計的鋼甲
hazmat_plate.desc_en: Plate armor designed to resist status ailments and magic damage.

neural_amplifier.name: 神經增幅器
neural_amplifier.desc_en: A device that amplifies magical output.

toxic_needle.name: 劇毒針
toxic_needle.desc: 細如髮絲卻致命的毒針
toxic_needle.desc_en: A hair-thin needle laced with deadly poison.

sky_pendant.name: 天空吊墜
sky_pendant.desc_en: A pendant light as a feather.

bone_reaper_scythe.name: 骸骨收割者
bone_reaper_scythe.desc_en: A reaping scythe wielded by necromancers.

spectral_shroud.name: 幽魂裹屍布
spectral_shroud.desc_en: A burial shroud wrapped in restless spirits.

grave_charm.name: 墓地護符
grave_charm.desc: 從古老墓穴中挖出的護符
grave_charm.desc_en: A charm unearthed from an ancient tomb.

soul_reaper_wand.name: 奪魂法杖
soul_reaper_wand.desc: 能奪取靈魂低語的法杖
soul_reaper_wand.desc_en: A wand that whispers of stolen souls.

wanderers_cloak.name: 流浪者披風
wanderers_cloak.desc: 長年旅行磨損的披風，行動格外輕盈
wanderers_cloak.desc_en: A well-worn traveling cloak that keeps you light on your feet.

crimson_rapier.name: 緋紅之劍
crimson_rapier.desc: 每次揮擊都能吸取些許生命力
crimson_rapier.desc_en: Every swing drains a sliver of life force.

noble_vampire_coat.name: 貴族血袍
noble_vampire_coat.desc_en: An ornate coat worn by vampire nobility.

blood_ring.name: 血之指環
blood_ring.desc_en: A ring set with a dark crimson gem.

vampiric_wand.name: 嗜血法杖
vampiric_wand.desc_en: A wand that thirsts for blood.

titan_warhammer.name: 泰坦戰鎚
titan_warhammer.desc: 需要驚人臂力才能揮動的巨鎚
titan_warhammer.desc_en: A massive hammer requiring immense strength to wield.

aegis_of_ages.name: 歲月神盾鎧
aegis_of_ages.desc_en: Armor bearing a shield passed down through the ages.

sage_ring.name: 賢者之戒
sage_ring.desc_en: A crystallization of a sage's wisdom.

arch_sage_rod.name: 大賢者權杖
arch_sage_rod.desc_en: A rod wielded only by arch-sages.

arcane_focus.name: 奧術聚焦石
arcane_focus.desc_en: A gem that helps focus magical energy.

dragon_scale_shield.name: 龍鱗護盾甲
dragon_scale_shield.desc: 以龍鱗打造的護盾式鎧甲

phoenix_blade.name: 鳳凰之刃
phoenix_blade.desc_en: A blade wreathed in undying flame.

phoenix_mail.name: 鳳凰羽甲
phoenix_mail.desc: 以鳳凰羽毛編織的鎧甲

phoenix_feather_charm.name: 鳳凰羽護符
phoenix_feather_charm.desc: 蘊含重生之力的羽毛護符
phoenix_feather_charm.desc_en: A feather charm imbued with the power of rebirth.

ancient_rune_band.name: 古代符文臂環
ancient_rune_band.desc_en: An armband etched with ancient runes.

voidwalker_glaive.name: 虛空行者長槍
voidwalker_glaive.desc_en: A light glaive drawn from the void.

voidwalker_plate.name: 虛空行者鎧甲
voidwalker_plate.desc: 虛空能量凝聚而成的鎧甲
voidwalker_plate.desc_en: Armor condensed from raw void energy.

voidwalker_band.name: 虛空行者臂環
voidwalker_band.desc: 漂浮著虛空微粒的臂環
voidwalker_band.desc_en: An armband drifting with void particles.

void_orb.name: 虛空法球
void_orb.desc_en: An orb that draws upon the power of the void.

champions_belt.name: 冠軍之帶
champions_belt.desc: 真正的冠軍才配得上的腰帶
champions_belt.desc_en: A belt fit only for a true champion.

netherblade.name: 冥界之刃
netherblade.desc: 斬過無數深淵魔物的刀刃
netherblade.desc_en: A blade that has cut down countless abyssal horrors.

netherplate.name: 冥界重鎧
netherplate.desc_en: Heavy, impenetrable armor from the netherworld.

nethercrown.name: 冥界之冠
nethercrown.desc_en: A crown radiating an ominous aura.

abyss_scepter.name: 深淵權杖
abyss_scepter.desc: 深淵能量凝聚而成的權杖
abyss_scepter.desc_en: A scepter condensed from abyssal energy.

dragon_heart.name: 龍族之心
dragon_heart.desc: 墮落巨龍體內仍在搏動的心臟，蘊含毀滅性的力量。
dragon_heart.desc_en: A still-beating heart from the Fallen Dragon, containing devastating power.

pure_blood_essence.name: 純淨的血之精華
pure_blood_essence.desc: 從吸血鬼真祖體內提煉出的純淨鮮血，是禁忌儀式的核心材料。
pure_blood_essence.desc_en: Purified blood drawn from the Vampire Progenitor, the core material of a forbidden ritual.

thunder_ward_shield.name: 雷擊盾
thunder_ward_shield.desc: 鑲嵌著雷擊之力的盾牌，裝備後【盾擊】會附帶對應屬性
thunder_ward_shield.desc_en: A shield imbued with thunder power; equipping it makes [Shield Bash] deal that element.

molten_shield.name: 熔岩盾
molten_shield.desc: 鑲嵌著熔岩之力的盾牌，裝備後【盾擊】會附帶對應屬性
molten_shield.desc_en: A shield imbued with molten power; equipping it makes [Shield Bash] deal that element.

glacier_shield.name: 冰霜盾
glacier_shield.desc: 鑲嵌著冰霜之力的盾牌，裝備後【盾擊】會附帶對應屬性
glacier_shield.desc_en: A shield imbued with glacier power; equipping it makes [Shield Bash] deal that element.

abyssal_shield.name: 深淵盾
abyssal_shield.desc: 鑲嵌著深淵之力的盾牌，裝備後【盾擊】會附帶對應屬性
abyssal_shield.desc_en: A shield imbued with abyssal power; equipping it makes [Shield Bash] deal that element.

dragon_scale_shard.name: 龍鱗碎片
dragon_scale_shard.desc: 從龍族身上剝落的赤紅鱗片，堅硬且蘊含熱量，是頂級鍛造材料
dragon_scale_shard.desc_en: A crimson scale shed by a dragon — hard, warm to the touch, and prized by master smiths.

drake_fang.name: 幼龍利牙
drake_fang.desc: 熔喉幼龍的尖牙，牙尖仍殘留著灼熱
drake_fang.desc_en: A moltenmaw drake's fang, its tip still searing hot.

void_shard.name: 虛空殘片
void_shard.desc: 裂隙生物體內凝結的空間碎片，凝視太久會頭暈
void_shard.desc_en: A splinter of condensed space from a rift creature. Staring at it too long makes you dizzy.

echo_herb.name: 回聲草
echo_herb.desc: 解除沉默狀態，讓你重新開口唸出咒語
echo_herb.desc_en: Cures the Silence status, letting you speak incantations again.

wyrmscale_barrier.name: 龍鱗壁壘
wyrmscale_barrier.desc: 以遠古炎龍的鱗片鍛成的重甲，僅能由工坊鍛造
wyrmscale_barrier.desc_en: Heavy armor forged from an ancient dragon's scales. Craftable only at the workshop.

voidforged_edge.name: 虛空鍛刃
voidforged_edge.desc: 以虛空殘片鍛成的黑刃，揮動時空間會隨之扭曲，僅能由工坊鍛造
voidforged_edge.desc_en: A black blade forged from void shards — space itself warps in its wake. Craftable only at the workshop.

lost_cat.name: 走失的貓
lost_cat.desc: 在森林裡找到的家貓，看起來有點受驚。
lost_cat.desc_en: A cat found in the forest.

holy_talisman.name: ✝️ 聖裁符咒
holy_talisman.desc: 戰鬥中釋放，對前排敵人造成 80 點神聖真實傷害（無視防禦、抗性與暴擊）。
holy_talisman.desc_en: Battle-only. Deals 80 holy true damage to the front enemy, ignoring defense, resistance, and critical hits.
